title: Assistant Designer, Crate&Barrel Kids
note: Furniture, lighting and decor design for the Kids brand; asks for a BFA in industrial or furniture design, 1+ year of technical design experience and SolidWorks.

facts.duties: Supports the product design team on kids' furniture, lighting and decor: sample tracking, vendor communication, technical specs by CAD and hand rendering, and keeping design briefs up to date.
facts.requirements: BFA in Industrial Design, Furniture Design or a related field; 1+ year with technical design and briefs; SolidWorks required, plus AutoCAD, Rhino, KeyShot and Adobe apps; strong hand sketching; knowledge of furniture construction.
facts.apply: Apply on the Workday posting; include a portfolio link (with password) on the resume or PDF samples.
